milestones.title: Verify component c01 at grouping level 1
Verify component c02 at grouping level 1

S1.instruction: Process current c01 source records in given order. Strip whitespace from every value; uppercase record_id and client, lowercase kind and status. Retain only records with status ok, nonempty normalized record_id and client, kind sale or refund, ASCII quantity [0-9]{1,2} whose value is 1..50, and unit_price matching [0-9]{1,5}.[0-9]{2} with a literal decimal point. Skip invalid records; among valid records retain only the first for each normalized record_id. Compute exact integer unit_cents from the decimal price and net_cents as quantity times unit_cents, negative for refunds and positive for sales. Sort retained rows lexically by record_id and emit the specified row fields.

S2.instruction: Using the current c01_rows artifact, group retained rows by normalized client in lexical order. For each client, count retained records and sum signed net_cents as exact integers. Produce c01_aggregates as an array of objects with client, count, and net_cents; do not count items or use floating-point arithmetic.

S3.instruction: Using the current c01_aggregates artifact, render c01_report with no trailing newline: first line CLIENT COUNT NET; then one line per client in lexical order as <client> <count> <net amount with exactly two decimal places>; final line TOTAL <retained record count> <grand net amount with exactly two decimal places>. Format cents exactly as decimal amounts, use single spaces, and include a minus sign only for negative amounts.

S4.instruction: Read the current c01 component revision and verify that the direct prerequisite c01_report passes against the current c01 environment. Produce c01_certify_1 with environment_revision equal to that revision and checked_gates exactly ["c01_report"], in that order; certify only if the prerequisite actually passes.

S5.instruction: Process current c02 source records in given order. Strip whitespace from every value; uppercase record_id and client, lowercase kind and status. Retain only records with status ok, nonempty normalized record_id and client, kind sale or refund, ASCII quantity [0-9]{1,2} whose value is 1..50, and unit_price matching [0-9]{1,5}.[0-9]{2} with a literal decimal point. Skip invalid records; among valid records retain only the first for each normalized record_id. For each retained record, derive unit_cents exactly from the price digits (for example, 22.76 becomes 2276), then calculate net_cents as quantity multiplied by unit_cents, negating only refunds. Verify each multiplication before emitting. Sort retained rows lexically by record_id and emit the specified row fields.

S6.instruction: Using the current c02_rows artifact, group retained rows by normalized client in lexical order. For each client, count retained records and sum signed net_cents as exact integers. Produce c02_aggregates as an array of objects with client, count, and net_cents; do not count items or use floating-point arithmetic.

S7.instruction: Using the current c02_aggregates artifact, render c02_report with no trailing newline: first line CLIENT COUNT NET; then one line per client in lexical order as <client> <count> <net amount with exactly two decimal places>; final line TOTAL <retained record count> <grand net amount with exactly two decimal places>. Format cents exactly as decimal amounts, use single spaces, and include a minus sign only for negative amounts.

S8.instruction: Read the current c02 component revision and verify that the direct prerequisite c02_report passes against the current c02 environment. Produce c02_certify_1 with environment_revision equal to that revision and checked_gates exactly ["c02_report"], in that order; certify only if the prerequisite actually passes.
